app.name: AIMayday
app.tagline: Calm, step-by-step help when something goes wrong.
lang.label: Language
status.label: Connection status
plan.keys: Tip: use the left and right arrow keys to move between steps.
plan.allDone: All steps checked. Keep following your IT contact's advice.
disclaimer: Guidance based on CISA, NIST and FBI advice. Not a replacement for professional IT, legal or law-enforcement help.
tile.ransomware: Files are locked or renamed and a message asks for payment.
tile.bec: An email asks to pay an invoice or to change bank details.
tile.phishing: Someone clicked a bad link, typed a password, or got a fake support call.
tile.lost-device: A laptop, phone, tablet or USB drive is lost or stolen.
tile.outage: Internet, power, email or an important system is down.
home.title: What is happening?
home.cleanDevice: Do not use the infected computer for this. Use your phone or another computer that shows no warning.
home.placeholder: For example: all files have a strange ending and a message asks for Bitcoin.
home.private: Your description stays on this device.
home.reading: Reading your description on this device…
home.unsure: Not sure what this is. Choose what fits best below.
home.opening: This looks like: {incident}. Opening the plan.

plan.notRight: Not the right plan? Choose another

log.notFound: This incident's plan is not on this device.
log.title: Incident log

log.photoType: Use a PNG or JPEG photo.
triage.title: Found on screen · please confirm
triage.reading: Reading the photo on this device…

triage.intro: Check each value against the screen and change anything that is wrong. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
triage.f.contact_method: How they say to contact them
triage.avoid: Do not contact the attackers or pay. This is kept for your report.
triage.noPlanYet: There is no plan for this yet. Keep following this plan and call your IT contact.

contacts.empty: No contacts saved on this device yet.
contacts.fixedDesc.ic3: Report cyber crime in the US
setup.title: Your business
setup.intro: Fill this in on a calm day. It stays on this device. It is used to fill your contacts card and to build your Offline Pack.
setup.f.name: Business name
setup.keySystemsHint: For example: patient records, card reader, shared drive
setup.contactsIntro: Add the people you would call. Leave a role empty if you do not have one.
setup.c.name: Name
nav.label: Main
setup.notSaved: Not saved. Check the fields and try again.
pack.title: Offline Pack
pack.intro: On a calm day, cloud AI writes answers to the questions people ask during an incident, fitted to your business. They are saved on this device. On incident day you can search them with no internet and no AI.
pack.none: No Offline Pack on this device yet.
pack.stale: Your setup changed since this Pack was built. Build it again to include the changes.
pack.needSetup: Fill in your business details first, so the answers fit your business.
pack.offline: Connect to the internet to build or update the Pack. Searching it works offline.
pack.job.retrying: Busy, trying again in {seconds} s ({attempt} of 3)
pack.job.dropped: {n} left out by the safety check
pack.err.busy: The AI service was busy. Your other answers are saved. Try this part again in a few minutes.
pack.err.access: The app could not get access to cloud AI. Your other answers are saved. Reload the page and try again.
pack.failedPart: 1 part of your Pack did not build. Everything else is saved and works offline.
pack.failedParts: {n} parts of your Pack did not build. Everything else is saved and works offline.
pack.alsoSent: Also sent: the steps of each built-in plan, in English and French, with fixed instructions. That is {n} separate requests.
pack.notSent: Not sent: your business name, city, contact names, phone numbers, emails, notes, incidents or photos.
pack.notSure: No sure answer in your Pack. These are the closest:
pack.nothing: No answer in your Pack for that.
preview.title: Before anything is sent
preview.gemini: Google Gemini (cloud) via Firebase AI Logic.
preview.whatSent: What is sent about your business
preview.exact: Show the exact text that will be sent
ask.open: Ask a question about this step
ask.label: Your question
ask.private: Answered on this device. Your question is not sent anywhere.
ask.cloudNotice: On this computer, questions about everyday IT problems may be answered by cloud AI. Don't type personal details.
ask.fromStep: Based on this step of your plan
ask.checkWith: If you are not sure, call your IT contact before you act.
ask.noPack: No answer on this device. Build the Offline Pack on a calm day for more answers.
ask.noAi: No answer on this device for this step. Your IT contact can help.
online.title: Back online
online.offline: When you are back online, cloud AI can write an incident report, next steps and messages for your staff, customers, bank and insurer from this log. Nothing is sent until you choose.
online.intro: Cloud AI can write these from this log. You see exactly what will be sent first.
online.includeNotes: Include my notes (they may contain names or numbers)
online.notSent: Not sent: photos, your business name, your contacts. Missing names are left as [placeholders] for you to fill in.
online.exact: Exact text that will be sent
online.failed: Cloud AI could not write this. Nothing was saved.
online.check: Written by cloud AI from your log. Read it and fill in the [placeholders] before you send it.
ready.title: Get ready
ready.intro: Do this on a calm day, while you are online. Then on incident day the app works offline on this device, with or without AI.
ready.app.ok: This app is saved on this device and opens with no internet.
ready.app.todo: Keep this page open online for a moment so it can save itself for offline use.
ready.profile.todo: Add your business details so the Pack fits your business.
ready.contacts.ok: {n} of 6 saved, including IT, bank fraud line and insurer.
ready.contacts.warn: {n} of 6 saved. Add your bank fraud line and insurer too: they matter most in the first hour.
ready.contacts.todo: Add at least your IT contact. Every plan step can call them in one tap.
ready.pack.warn: Built {date}, but your setup changed since. Build it again.
ready.pack.todo: Not built yet. It needs the internet once, then works offline.
ready.printed.ok: Printed {date}. Keep the paper near the front desk.
ready.printed.todo: Print your plans and contacts. Paper works when no device does.
ready.ondevice.warm: Available and loaded on this device. It reads ransom screens and answers questions with no internet.
ready.ondevice.available: Available on this device. It reads ransom screens and answers questions with no internet.
ready.ondevice.downloadable: This device can run on-device AI after a one-time download (several GB). Optional: the Offline Pack works without it.
ready.ondevice.none: Not available on this device. That is fine: the Offline Pack and the checklist work without it.
print.title: Print your plans
print.intro: Every plan, every step, the everyday IT fix-its, and your contacts on paper. Keep it near the front desk and update it when your contacts change.
triage.cloud.what: What is sent: this image and fixed instructions to read the screen. No name, no contacts, no log.
triage.cloud.sending: Cloud AI is reading the image
triage.cloud.differs: Cloud AI read some fields differently. Your fields are unchanged: choose "Use this" only where it is right.
triage.cloud.same: Cloud AI found nothing different. Your fields are unchanged.
triage.cloud.failed: Cloud check didn't work. The fields above are unchanged.
triage.cloud.imageAlt: The photo that will be sent
demo.title: Demo setup
demo.intro: Loads a made-up business so you can film or test without real data. Nothing here is sent anywhere.
demo.what: Sunrise Dental, Riverdale GA, 6 staff, with invented contacts (555-01xx numbers). It replaces the business details and contacts on this device.
demo.loaded: Demo data loaded. Every screen now shows a "Demo data" line.
demo.resetWhat: Deletes everything this app saved on this device: incidents, photos, business details, contacts, the Offline Pack and the language choice. The app itself stays installed.
demo.banner: Demo data · Sunrise Dental is a made-up business
fixit.title: Everyday IT problems
fixit.homeTitle: Everyday IT problems, not an attack
fixit.intro: Simple checks for common problems. Each step has a source. If something looks like an attack, open the matching plan.
fixit.attackText: Strange messages, files you cannot open or a ransom note are not everyday problems. Use the incident plan.
fixit.desc.wifi: No internet on one computer or the whole office.
fixit.desc.email-send: Messages stay in the Outbox or bounce back.
fixit.desc.frozen-pc: An app or the whole computer stops responding.
fixit.desc.printer: Jobs stay stuck or nothing comes out.
fixit.desc.locked-account: Microsoft, Google or another account is locked.
fixit.desc.power: The power is off in the office.
